reason: Version 2 preserves the structural-decline claim, the hedged “potential returns,” investment and customer-capture plans, and proposed mitigations, with only minor wording shifts. Version 1 misstates the decline as “for good reasons we can’t reverse” and puts talent and inventory “in one place,” but Version 3 changes more claims and caveats—dropping “structurally,” turning “stronger potential returns” into “should return more,” and shifting capture, investment, and mitigations into firmer commitments.
